question: Fill in the blank: The National Institute of Sports, founded in 1961 at the former Patiala Palace, was renamed the Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports (NSNIS) on ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**23 January 1973.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Institute of Sports (NIS):** The **National Institute of Sports (NIS)** was founded in **1961** at the former **Patiala Palace**, also known as the Moti Bagh Palace, in **Patiala, Punjab**.
 
• This institution was established to promote the development of sports and train athletes and coaches in various sports disciplines in India.
 
• **Renaming to Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports (NSNIS):** On **January 23, 1973**, the institute was renamed as the **Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports (NSNIS)** in honor of **Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose**, a prominent Indian freedom fighter known for his contributions to India's independence movement.
 
• This renaming occurred on the **birthday of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose**, commemorating his legacy and his contribution to India's history. *Hence, the correct answer is option 3.*
 
• The NSNIS has since become an integral part of the sports ecosystem in India, offering **training programs, courses, and research** to enhance the development of athletes and coaches.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports (NSNIS):**

 
 
• The NSNIS is widely regarded as the "Mecca of Indian Sports" due to its critical role in developing and nurturing sports talent in the country.
 
• The institute offers various programs such as **coaching courses, diploma programs, and research opportunities** in sports science and physical education.
 
• It also serves as a venue for **national and international sports events**, providing modern facilities and infrastructure for athletes.
 
 
 
• **Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose:**
 
 
• **Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose** was a prominent leader in India's struggle for independence. He is remembered for his efforts to lead the Indian National Army (INA) and his slogan, "Give me blood, and I will give you freedom."
 
• Bose's legacy is celebrated every year on his birthday, **January 23**. The renaming of the National Institute of Sports to NSNIS was a tribute to his contributions.
 
 
 
• **Importance of NSNIS:**
 
 
• The NSNIS has played a crucial role in producing numerous accomplished athletes and coaches who have represented India on international platforms.
 
• The institute provides specialized training in various sports disciplines, including athletics, hockey, football, wrestling, and more.
 
• It also facilitates research and development in sports science to enhance performance and address athlete health and fitness.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Sports Infrastructure:**

 
 
• NSNIS has state-of-the-art infrastructure, including gymnasiums, training fields, and swimming pools, catering to various sports disciplines.
 
• The institute conducts regular workshops and seminars for athletes and coaches to enhance their knowledge and skills.
 
 
 
• **Legacy of January 23:**
 
 
• January 23 is celebrated as the birthday of **Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose**. This day holds historical significance for India, symbolizing patriotism and the fight for independence.
 
• The renaming of the institute on this day signifies the nation's respect and admiration for his leadership and sacrifice.
